model.historical_method: Current 7 teams; prior-season relative points/game and goal difference/game, shrunk to account for cohort change. Missing historical records get neutral prior. No legacy initial strength values used.
model.current_season_method: Six recorded girls league results, including organiser-confirmed Dacorum 1–5 Newbury; capped goal margins and conservative opponent adjustment.
model.remaining_fixture_method: 36 unplayed home-away pairings, 2.8 expected goals per match, 1.05 home multiplier.
model.tie_break_assumption: Championship points 3/2/1; ties for highest points divided equally across tied teams because official title tie-break is unverified.
model.sensitivity: Primary seed independently repeated, 2nd seed stable; alternate historical/current season weighting tested. Forecasts sensitive to weights due to limited results.

model_note: Six girls league scores recorded; new Dacorum 1–5 Newbury result confirmed by GPSFA result grid and league table in 11 Oct user-supplied screenshots. Championship estimates recalculated on 36 remaining home-away pairings using previous documented V4 assumptions, 100,000 seasons, and equal credit for teams tied at the top. Other match-specific source verifications remain outstanding.
